question: Rotation selector precedence, extra ordinary operands and ordered range validation
source:

' $?; dirs -l -p; pushd -n +1 +2; printf 'lastSelector=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p; pushd +99 +0; printf 'earlyRange=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p

question: popd last selector and --; dirs ignores tokens after -- but retains flags
source:
pushd -n a; pushd -n b; pushd -n c; popd +1 +2; printf 'lastPop=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p; popd -- +99; printf 'popMarker=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p; dirs -p -- +99 bad; printf 'dirsMarker=%s
' $?; dirs -c -- bad; printf 'clearMarker=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p

question: Signed 64-bit boundary and signs/whitespace inside numeric selectors
source:

' $?; dirs +9223372036854775808; printf 'over=%s
' $?; dirs ++1; printf 'doublePlus=%s
' $?; dirs '+ 1'; printf 'space=%s
' $?; dirs +-1; printf 'negativeMagnitude=%s
' $?; dirs -l -p
